column3: the  franchisor provides notice that (x) there is a default by the borrower under the franchise  agreement or (y) the Marriott Albuquerque Property is not being operated or maintained in  accordance with the franchisor’s standards, resulting in the borrower no longer being  in good standing with the franchisor, and such default is not cured within 30 days of such  notice, and continue until such default has been remedied to the satisfaction of the lender  and the franchisor, as evidenced by an estoppel or other documentation from the franchisor  reasonably satisfactory to the lender;
